verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official, first-party Salesforce MCP server documented at github.com/salesforcecli/mcp, which an external agent can connect to. That covers the core of the story. The Agentforce Builder ability to plug in third-party MCP servers is client-side and is not credited here. Missing for 10: details of the MCP server's tools and Sales Cloud data coverage, setup and auth documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting through it.
